label: Conversational
description: The Partner. Best for general assistance and interactive debugging. Executes one task at a time while maintaining a continuous history to build on previous results.

label: Waterfall
description: The Architect. Best for well-defined, linear projects. Generates a complete sequential plan for review before execution, ensuring a clear path to the solution.

label: Adaptive
description: The Strategist. Best for complex, 'fuzzy' problems. Uses an iterative 'Think-Act-Reflect' loop to dynamically adjust its strategy based on task results.

label: Persona
description: The Roleplayer. Best for specialized consulting. Adopts specific cognitive strategies and maintains an evolving internal persona state throughout the conversation.

label: Protocol
description: The Auditor. Best for strict workflows. Enforces methodologies using a state machine and a 'Referee' agent to validate output before moving to the next stage.

label: Council
description: The Board. Best for high-stakes decisions. Simulates a meeting between specialized AI personas who nominate and vote on tasks to ensure technical feasibility.

label: Parallel
description: The Multitasker. Best for batch processing. Runs multiple tasks simultaneously using templates and variables, ideal for automating actions across many files.

label: Hierarchical
description: The Manager. Best for massive projects with many dependencies. Decomposes requests into a goal tree with real-time visual progress tracking.
